amenitiesDescription:
ORA is built around Bosco — a 40-foot sky park soaring 500 feet above Brickell, with walking paths, a meditation and sculpture garden, a recreational lawn, and live programming: film screenings, yoga, pilates, and music.

The 9th-floor resort pool features loungers, cabanas, and a sun shelf amid lush landscaping. Two full floors are dedicated to fitness and wellness, including an 18,000 SF center, spa, vitality pool, and yoga and pilates studios.

Four Casa Tua dining concepts anchor the building: Terra (24-hour gourmet market and bakery), Uva (enoteca with 500+ wines and Mediterranean cuisine), Fuoco (wood-burning fire restaurant), and Vento (rooftop lounge with jacuzzi pool, private dining, and entertainment stage). Co-working spaces, a clubroom, 24-hour concierge, and 24-hour valet complete the offering.
architectQuote: Casa Tua transforms spaces with soul. Our job was to give that soul a tower worthy of it.

investmentThesis: Casa Tua has cultivated an intensely loyal following among ultra-high-net-worth clientele for over two decades — ORA is the brand's first residential tower, a natural extension for an established global buyer base that already knows the brand intimately. Fortune International Group brings proven Brickell execution to the project, with delivery targeted for 2029. Short-term rental eligibility is rare at this address: the vast majority of Brickell luxury towers require minimum 6-to-12-month leases, making ORA one of the very few assets in the corridor with hotel-program nightly yield potential. The fully furnished, turnkey delivery model eliminates post-closing friction and accelerates income-ready occupancy for international and seasonal buyers.
name: Ora by Casa Tua
residenceContent: Arquitectonica's 76-story tower at 1210 Brickell Avenue is designed around the Casa Tua philosophy: warm, layered, and personal rather than minimal or corporate. Every one of the 540 residences arrives fully furnished and turnkey by Italian design house m2atelier, from studio to four-bedroom. Interiors feature 10-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling glass, generous terraces, European oak flooring, custom Italian kitchens with integrated Miele appliances, and bathrooms with book-matched stone and rain showers. Arrival is through a canopy of tropical plantings and water features, with a ground-floor restaurant and private club for residents.
